label.en: supreme commander of all armies and horses under Heaven

value.action: Jurchen envoys again demanded Ashu; Liao did not hand him over
sent to ask why Jurchen built many border castles
plotted with younger brothers, appointed commanders, gathered Jurchen troops, captured Liao border hawk officials, and attacked Ningjiang Prefecture
was shooting deer at Qing Prefecture and took little concern on hearing of the Ningjiang attack

label.en: sweeping pardon of routed eastern expedition troops

value.action: encountered Jurchen and fought east of Ningjiang; was defeated
appointed deputy under Xiao Sixian and marched to encamp at Chuhe Store
led army to encamp at Chuhe Store; army collapsed after Jurchen surprise attack across Huntong River
encamped east of Wolin Marsh and was struck by Jurchen; many soldiers died
appointed field army commander-in-chief with Xiao Yixue and Yelü Zhangnu as deputies
went to relieve Bin Prefecture and was defeated by Jurchen
went to relieve Xian Prefecture and was defeated by Jurchen
went to relieve Xian Prefecture and was defeated by Jurchen

units.zh: 天祚皇帝，諱延禧，字延甯，小字阿果。
units.en: Emperor Tianzuo, taboo name Yanxi, courtesy name Yanning, childhood name Aguo.
units.literal: Emperor Tianzuo, taboo name Yanxi, courtesy name Yanning, childhood name Aguo.

units.zh: 道宗之孫，父順宗大孝順聖皇帝，母貞順皇后蕭氏。
units.en: He was Daozong's grandson; his father was Emperor Shunzong, the Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor; his mother was Empress Zhenshun of the Xiao clan.
units.literal: He was Daozong's grandson; his father was Emperor Shunzong, the Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor; his mother was Empress Zhenshun of the Xiao clan.

units.zh: 大康元年生。
units.en: He was born in the first year of Dakang.
units.literal: He was born in the first year of Dakang.

units.zh: 六歲封梁王，加守太尉，兼中書令。
units.en: At age six he was enfeoffed Prince of Liang, promoted Defender of the State grand mentor, and made concurrently Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: At age six he was enfeoffed Prince of Liang, promoted Defender of the State grand mentor, and made concurrently Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 後三年，進封燕國王。
units.en: Three years later he was advanced to Prince of Yan.
units.literal: Three years later he was advanced to Prince of Yan.

units.zh: 大安七年，總北南院樞密使事，加尚書令，為天下兵馬大元帥。
units.en: In the seventh year of Da'an he oversaw Northern and Southern Privy Council affairs, was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and became supreme commander of all armies and horses under Heaven.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Da'an he oversaw Northern and Southern Privy Council affairs, was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and became supreme commander of all armies and horses under Heaven.

units.zh: 壽隆七年[1]正月甲戌，道宗崩，奉遺詔即皇帝位於柩前。
units.en: In the seventh year of Shoulong [1], on jiaxu day of the first month Daozong died; by testamentary edict Tianzuo assumed the throne before the coffin.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Shoulong [1], first month, on jiaxu day, Daozong died; by testamentary edict he assumed the imperial dignity before the coffin.

units.zh: 群臣上尊號曰天祚皇帝。
units.en: The hundred officials offered the honorific title Emperor Tianzuo.
units.literal: The hundred officials offered the honorific title Emperor Tianzuo.

units.zh: 二月壬辰朔，改元乾統，大赦。
units.en: On the renchen new moon of the second month the era name was changed to Qiantong and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: Second month, on renchen new moon, the era name was changed to Qiantong and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 詔為耶律乙辛所誣陷者，復其官爵，籍沒者出之，流放者還之。
units.en: An edict ordered restoration of office and rank for those framed by Yelü Yixin, return of confiscated property, and recall of the exiled.
units.literal: An edict ordered that those framed by Yelü Yixin should have office and rank restored; those whose property had been confiscated should have it returned; those exiled should be brought back.

units.zh: 乙未，遣使告哀于宋及西夏、高麗。
units.en: On yiwei day envoys were sent to announce mourning to Song, Western Xia, and Goryeo.
units.literal: On yiwei day envoys were dispatched to announce mourning to Song and to Western Xia and Goryeo.

units.zh: 乙巳，以北府宰相蕭兀納為遼興軍節度使，加守太傅。
units.en: On yisi day Northern Court chancellor Xiao Wuna was made military commissioner of Liaoxing Army and promoted Defender of the State grand mentor.
units.literal: On yisi day Northern Court chancellor Xiao Wuna was made military commissioner of Liaoxing Army and promoted Defender of the State grand mentor.

units.zh: 三月丁卯，詔有司以張孝傑家屬分賜群臣。
units.en: On dingmao day of the third month an edict ordered the relevant offices to distribute Zhang Xiaojie's family members among the hundred officials.
units.literal: Third month, on dingmao day, an edict ordered the relevant offices to distribute Zhang Xiaojie's family members among the hundred officials.

units.zh: 甲戌，召僧法頤放戒於內庭。
units.en: On jiaxu day the monk Fayi was summoned to grant precepts in the inner court.
units.literal: On jiaxu day the monk Fayi was summoned to grant precepts in the inner court.

units.zh: 夏四月，旱。
units.en: That summer, in the fourth month, there was drought.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, drought.

units.zh: 六月庚寅朔，如慶州。
units.en: On the gengyin new moon of the sixth month the court went to Qing Prefecture.
units.literal: Sixth month, on gengyin new moon, went to Qing Prefecture.

units.zh: 甲午，宋遣王潛等來弔祭。
units.en: On jiawu day Song sent Wang Qian and others to offer mourning sacrifices.
units.literal: On jiawu day Song dispatched Wang Qian and others to offer mourning sacrifices.

units.zh: 丙申，高麗、夏國各遣使慰奠。
units.en: On bingshen day Goryeo and Xia State each sent envoys to offer condolences.
units.literal: On bingshen day Goryeo and Xia State each dispatched envoys to offer condolences.

units.zh: 戊戌，以南府宰相斡特剌兼南院樞密使。
units.en: On wuxu day Southern Court chancellor Wotela was also made Southern Court privy commissioner.
units.literal: On wuxu day Southern Court chancellor Wotela was also made Southern Court privy commissioner.

units.zh: 庚子，追懿德皇后為宣懿皇后。
units.en: On gengzi day Empress Yide was posthumously titled Empress Xuanyi.
units.literal: On gengzi day Virtuous Consort was posthumously titled Empress Xuanyi.

units.zh: 壬寅，以宋魏國王和魯斡為天下兵馬大元帥。
units.en: On renyin day the Prince of Song and Wei, Heluwo, was made supreme commander of all armies and horses under heaven.
units.literal: On renyin day Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made supreme commander of all armies and horses under heaven.

units.zh: 乙巳，以北平郡王淳進封鄭王。
units.en: On yisi day Prince of Beiping Commandery Chun was advanced to Prince of Zheng.
units.literal: On yisi day Prince of Beiping Commandery Chun was advanced to Prince of Zheng.

units.zh: 丁未，北院樞密使耶律阿思加於越。
units.en: On dingwei day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Asi was promoted yuyue.
units.literal: On dingwei day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Asi was promoted yuyue.

units.zh: 辛亥，葬仁聖大孝文皇帝、宣懿皇后于慶陵。
units.en: On xinhai day the Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor and Empress Xuanyi were buried at Qing Mausoleum.
units.literal: On xinhai day the Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor and Empress Xuanyi were buried at Qing Mausoleum.

units.zh: 秋七月癸亥，阻卜、鐵驪來貢。
units.en: On guihai day of the seventh autumn month Zubu and Iron Li came with tribute.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guihai day Zubu and Iron Li came with tribute.

units.zh: 八月甲寅，謁慶陵。
units.en: On jiayin day of the eighth month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
units.literal: Eighth month, on jiayin day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

units.zh: 九月壬申，謁懷陵。
units.en: On renshen day of the ninth month the court paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.
units.literal: Ninth month, on renshen day paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.

units.zh: 乙亥，駐蹕藕絲澱。
units.en: On yihai day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
units.literal: On yihai day halted at Ousi Marsh.

units.zh: 冬十月壬辰，謁乾陵。
units.en: On renchen day of the tenth winter month the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renchen day paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 甲辰，上皇考昭懷太子曰大孝順聖皇帝，廟號順宗，皇妣曰貞順皇后。
units.en: On jiachen day the late imperial father, Heir Apparent Zhaohuai, was titled Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor with temple name Shunzong; the late imperial mother was titled Empress Zhenshun.
units.literal: On jiachen day the late imperial father, Heir Apparent Zhaohuai, was titled Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor with temple name Shunzong; the late imperial mother was titled Empress Zhenshun.

units.zh: 十二月戊子，以樞密副使張琳知樞密院事，翰林學士張奉三知政事兼同知樞密院事。
units.en: On wuzi day of the twelfth month Deputy Privy Commissioner Zhang Lin was made knower of privy council affairs; Hanlin academician Zhang Fengsan was made knower of government affairs and concurrently associate knower of privy council affairs.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on wuzi day Deputy Privy Commissioner Zhang Lin was made knower of privy council affairs; Hanlin academician Zhang Fengsan was made knower of government affairs and concurrently associate knower of privy council affairs.

units.zh: 癸巳，宋遣黃實來賀即位。
units.en: On guisi day Song sent Huang Shi to congratulate the accession.
units.literal: On guisi day Song dispatched Huang Shi to congratulate the accession.

units.zh: 丁酉，高麗、夏國並遣使來賀。
units.en: On dingyou day Goryeo and Xia State each sent envoys to congratulate.
units.literal: On dingyou day Goryeo and Xia State each dispatched envoys to congratulate.

units.zh: 乙巳，詔先朝已行事，不得陳告。
units.en: On yisi day an edict ordered that matters already settled in former reigns might not be reported in accusatory memorials.
units.literal: On yisi day an edict ordered that matters already settled in former reigns might not be reported in accusatory memorials.

units.zh: 初，以楊割為生女直部節度使，其俗呼為太師。
units.en: Initially Yangge was made military commissioner of the Raw Jurchen Division; their custom called him Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: Initially Yangge was made military commissioner of the Raw Jurchen Division; their custom called him Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 是歲楊割死，傳于兄之子烏雅束，束死，其弟阿骨打襲。
units.en: That year Yangge died and the post passed to his elder brother's son Wugusun; when Wugusun died, his younger brother Aguda succeeded.
units.literal: That year Yangge died and the post passed to his elder brother's son Wugusun; when Wugusun died, his younger brother Aguda succeeded.

units.zh: 二年春正月，如鴨子河。
units.en: In the second year, in the first spring month the court went to Huntong River.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, went to Huntong River.

units.zh: 二月辛卯，如春州。
units.en: On xinmao day of the second month the court went to Chun Prefecture.
units.literal: Second month, on xinmao day went to Chun Prefecture.

units.zh: 三月，大寒，冰復合。
units.en: In the third month there was great cold and the ice formed again.
units.literal: Third month, great cold; ice formed again.

units.zh: 夏四月辛亥，詔誅乙辛黨，徙其子孫于邊；
units.en: On xinhai day of the fourth summer month an edict ordered execution of Yixin's faction and relocation of their sons and grandsons to the border;
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinhai day, an edict ordered execution of Yixin's faction and relocation of their sons and grandsons to the border;

units.zh: 發乙辛、得里特之墓，剖棺，戮屍；
units.en: Yixin's and Delite's tombs were opened, coffins split, and corpses dismembered;
units.literal: Yixin's and Delite's tombs were opened, coffins split, and corpses dismembered;

units.zh: 以其家屬分賜被殺之家。
units.en: their families were distributed to the households of those who had been killed.
units.literal: their families were distributed to the households of those who had been killed.

units.zh: 五月乙丑，斡特剌獻耶睹刮等部捷。
units.en: On yichou day of the fifth month Wotela presented the victory of the Yeduoge and other divisions.
units.literal: Fifth month, on yichou day Wotela presented the victory of the Yeduoge and other divisions.

units.zh: 六月壬辰，以雨罷獵，駐蹕散水原。
units.en: On renchen day of the sixth month, because of rain the hunt was abandoned and the court halted at Sanshui Plain.
units.literal: Sixth month, on renchen day, because of rain the hunt was abandoned and the court halted at Sanshui Plain.

units.zh: 丙午，夏國王李乾順復遣使請尚公主。
units.en: On bingwu day Xia King Li Qianshun again sent envoys requesting marriage to a princess.
units.literal: On bingwu day Xia King Li Qianshun again dispatched envoys requesting marriage to a princess.

units.zh: 丁未，南院大王陳家奴致仕。
units.en: On dingwei day Southern Court great king Chenjianu retired.
units.literal: On dingwei day Southern Court great king Chenjianu retired.

units.zh: 壬子，李乾順為宋所攻，遣李造福、田若水求援。
units.en: On renzi day Li Qianshun, attacked by Song, dispatched Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.
units.literal: On renzi day Li Qianshun, attacked by Song, dispatched Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.

units.zh: 閏月庚申，策賢良。
units.en: On gengshen day of the intercalary month worthy talent was examined.
units.literal: Intercalary month, on gengshen day, examination of worthy talent.

units.zh: 壬申，降惠妃為庶人。
units.en: On renshen day Favored Consort was demoted to commoner.
units.literal: On renshen day Favored Consort was demoted to commoner.

units.zh: 秋七月，獵黑嶺，以霖雨，給獵人馬。
units.en: In the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Black Ridge; because of heavy rain horses were given to the hunters.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, hunted at Black Ridge; because of heavy rain, horses were given to the hunters.

units.zh: 阻卜來侵，斡特剌等戰敗之。
units.en: When Zubu came to invade, Wotela and others defeated them.
units.literal: Zubu came to invade; Wotela and others defeated them.

units.zh: 冬十月乙卯，蕭海里叛，劫乾州武庫器甲。
units.en: On yimao day of the tenth winter month Xiao Haili rebelled and plundered the armory of Qian Prefecture.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yimao day Xiao Haili rebelled and plundered the armory of Qian Prefecture.

units.zh: 命北面林牙郝家奴捕之，蕭海里亡入陪術水阿典部。
units.en: Northern Court linya Hao Jianu was ordered to capture him; Xiao Haili fled into the Adian division of the Peishu River.
units.literal: Northern Court linya Hao Jianu was ordered to capture him; Xiao Haili fled into the Adian division of the Peishu River.

units.zh: 丙寅，以南府宰相耶律斡特剌為北院樞密使，三知政事牛溫舒知南院樞密使事。
units.en: On bingyin day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Wotela was made Northern Court privy commissioner; third associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs.
units.literal: On bingyin day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Wotela was made Northern Court privy commissioner; third associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs.

units.zh: 十一月乙未，郝家奴以不獲蕭海里，免官。
units.en: On yiwei day of the eleventh month Hao Jianu, for failing to capture Xiao Haili, was dismissed from office.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on yiwei day Hao Jianu, for failing to capture Xiao Haili, was dismissed from office.

units.zh: 壬寅，以上京留守耶律慎思為北院樞密副使。
units.en: On renyin day Supreme Capital intendant Yelü Shensi was made associate Northern Court privy commissioner.
units.literal: On renyin day Supreme Capital intendant Yelü Shensi was made associate Northern Court privy commissioner.

units.zh: 有司請以帝生日為天興節。
units.en: The relevant offices requested that the emperor's birthday be made the Tianxing Festival.
units.literal: The relevant offices requested that the emperor's birthday be made the Tianxing Festival.

units.zh: 三年春正月辛巳朔，如混同江。
units.en: In the third year, on the xinsi new moon of the first spring month the court went to Huntong River.
units.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on xinsi new moon, went to Huntong River.

units.zh: 女直函蕭海里首，遣使來獻。
units.en: Jurchen sent Xiao Haili's head in a box and dispatched envoys to present it.
units.literal: Jurchen sent Xiao Haili's head in a box and dispatched envoys to present it.

units.zh: 戊申，如春州。
units.en: On wushen day the court went to Chun Prefecture.
units.literal: On wushen day went to Chun Prefecture.

units.zh: 二月庚午，以武清縣大水，弛其陂澤之禁。
units.en: On gengwu day of the second month, because of great flood at Wuqing County, prohibitions on ponds and marshes were relaxed.
units.literal: Second month, on gengwu day, because of great flood at Wuqing County, prohibitions on ponds and marshes were relaxed.

units.zh: 夏五月戊子，以獵人多亡，嚴立科禁。
units.en: On wuzi day of the fifth summer month, because many hunters had fled, strict statutes were established.
units.literal: Summer, fifth month, on wuzi day, because many hunters had fled, strict statutes were established.

units.zh: 乙巳，清暑赤勒嶺。
units.en: On yisi day the court took summer ease at Chile Ridge.
units.literal: On yisi day took summer ease at Chile Ridge.

units.zh: 丙午，謁慶陵。
units.en: On bingwu day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
units.literal: On bingwu day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

units.zh: 六月辛酉，夏國王李乾順復遣使請尚公主。
units.en: On xinyou day of the sixth month Xia King Li Qianshun again sent envoys requesting marriage to a princess.
units.literal: Sixth month, on xinyou day Xia King Li Qianshun again dispatched envoys requesting marriage to a princess.

units.zh: 秋七月，中京雨雹，傷稼。
units.en: In the seventh autumn month hail at Central Capital damaged the crops.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, at Central Capital hail damaged the crops.

units.zh: 冬十月甲辰，如中京。
units.en: On jiachen day of the tenth winter month the court went to Central Capital.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiachen day went to Central Capital.

units.zh: 己未，吐蕃遣使來貢。
units.en: On jiwei day Tibet sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On jiwei day Tibet dispatched envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 庚申，夏國復遣使求援。
units.en: On gengshen day Xia State again sent envoys seeking aid.
units.literal: On gengshen day Xia State again dispatched envoys seeking aid.

units.zh: 己巳，有事於觀德殿。
units.en: On jisi day rites were performed at Guande Hall.
units.literal: On jisi day rites were performed at Guande Hall.

units.zh: 十一月丙申，文武百官加上尊號曰惠文智武聖孝天祚皇帝，大赦，以宋魏國王和魯斡為皇太叔，梁王撻魯進封燕國王，鄭王淳為東京留守，進封越國王，百官各進一階。
units.en: On bingshen day of the eleventh month civil and military officials added the honorific title Benevolent, Cultured, Wise, Martial, Sagely, Filial Emperor Tianzuo; a general amnesty was proclaimed; Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made Imperial Grand Uncle; Prince of Liang Taluo was advanced to Prince of Yan; Prince of Zheng Chun was made Eastern Capital intendant and advanced to Prince of Yue; all officials were promoted one grade.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on bingshen day civil and military officials added the honorific title Benevolent, Cultured, Wise, Martial, Sagely, Filial Emperor Tianzuo; general amnesty; Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made Imperial Grand Uncle; Prince of Liang Taluo was advanced to Prince of Yan; Prince of Zheng Chun was made Eastern Capital intendant and advanced to Prince of Yue; all officials were promoted one grade.

units.zh: 丁酉，以惕隱耶律何魯掃古為南院大王。
units.en: On dingyou day tiyin Yelü Heluosaogu was made Southern Court great king.
units.literal: On dingyou day tiyin Yelü Heluosaogu was made Southern Court great king.

units.zh: 戊戌，以受尊號，告廟。
units.en: On wuxu day, because of receiving the honorific title, announcement was made at the ancestral temple.
units.literal: On wuxu day, because of receiving the honorific title, announcement was made at the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 乙巳，謁太祖廟，追尊太祖之高祖曰昭烈皇帝，廟號肅祖，妣曰昭烈皇后；
units.en: On yisi day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple; Taizu's great-great-grandfather was posthumously titled Emperor Zhaolie with temple name Suzu; his consort was titled Empress Zhaolie.
units.literal: On yisi day paid respects at Taizu's temple; Taizu's great-great-grandfather was posthumously titled Emperor Zhaolie with temple name Suzu; his consort was titled Empress Zhaolie.

units.zh: 曾祖曰莊敬皇帝，廟號懿祖，妣曰莊敬皇后。
units.en: The great-grandfather was titled Emperor Zhuangjing with temple name Yizu; his consort was titled Empress Zhuangjing.
units.literal: Great-grandfather was titled Emperor Zhuangjing with temple name Yizu; his consort was titled Empress Zhuangjing.

units.zh: 召監修國史耶律儼纂太祖諸帝實錄。
units.en: Supervisor of compilation of the national history Yelü Yan was summoned to compile Veritable Records of the various emperors from Taizu onward.
units.literal: Supervisor of compilation of the national history Yelü Yan was summoned to compile Veritable Records of the various emperors from Taizu onward.

units.zh: 十二月戊申，如藕絲澱。
units.en: On wushen day of the twelfth month the court went to Ousi Marsh.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on wushen day went to Ousi Marsh.

units.zh: 是年，放進士馬恭回等百三人。
units.en: That year advanced scholars Ma Gonghui and one hundred three others were released.
units.literal: That year advanced scholars Ma Gonghui and one hundred three others were released.

units.zh: 四年春正月戊子，幸魚兒濼。
units.en: In the fourth year, on wuzi day of the first spring month the court visited Yuer Marsh.
units.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on wuzi day, visited Yuer Marsh.

units.zh: 壬寅，獵木嶺。
units.en: On renyin day the court hunted at Muling Ridge.
units.literal: On renyin day hunted at Muling Ridge.

units.zh: 癸卯，燕國王撻魯薨。
units.en: On guimao day Prince of Yan Taluo died.
units.literal: On guimao day Prince of Yan Taluo died.

units.zh: 二月丁丑，鼻骨德遣使來貢。
units.en: On dingchou day of the second month the Nose-bone tribe sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: Second month, on dingchou day the Nose-bone tribe dispatched envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 夏六月甲辰，駐蹕旺國崖。
units.en: On jiachen day of the sixth summer month the court halted at Wangguo Cliff.
units.literal: Summer, sixth month, on jiachen day halted at Wangguo Cliff.

units.zh: 甲寅，夏國遣李造福、田若水求援。
units.en: On jiayin day Xia State sent Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.
units.literal: On jiayin day Xia State dispatched Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.

units.zh: 癸亥，吐蕃遣使來貢。
units.en: On guihai day Tibet sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On guihai day Tibet dispatched envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 秋七月，南京蝗。
units.en: In the seventh autumn month there were locusts at Nanjing.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, locusts at Nanjing.

units.zh: 庚辰，獵南山。
units.en: On gengchen day the court hunted at Southern Mountain.
units.literal: On gengchen day hunted at Southern Mountain.

units.zh: 癸未，以西北路招討使蕭得里底、北院樞密副使耶律慎思並知北院樞密使事。
units.en: On guiwei day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Delidi and associate Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Shensi both administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs.
units.literal: On guiwei day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Delidi and associate Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Shensi both administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs.

units.zh: 辛卯，以同知南院樞密使事蕭敵里為西北路招討使。
units.en: On xinmao day associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Dili was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.
units.literal: On xinmao day associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Dili was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 冬十月己酉，鳳凰見於陰。
units.en: On jiyou day of the tenth winter month a phoenix appeared at Yin.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiyou day a phoenix appeared at Yin.

units.zh: 己未，幸南京。
units.en: On jiwei day the court went to Nanjing.
units.literal: On jiwei day went to Nanjing.

units.zh: 十一月乙亥，禦迎月樓，賜貧民錢。
units.en: On yihai day of the eleventh month at Welcome Moon Tower money was bestowed on poor people.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on yihai day at Welcome Moon Tower money was bestowed on poor people.

units.zh: 十二月辛丑，以張琳為南府宰相。
units.en: On xinchou day of the twelfth month Zhang Lin was made Southern Court chancellor.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on xinchou day Zhang Lin was made Southern Court chancellor.

units.zh: 五年春正月乙亥，夏國遣李造福等來求援，且乞伐宋。
units.en: In the fifth year, on yihai day of the first spring month Xia State sent Li Zaofu and others to seek aid and also requested an attack on Song.
units.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on yihai day Xia State dispatched Li Zaofu and others to seek aid and also requested an attack on Song.

units.zh: 庚寅，以遼興軍節度使蕭常哥為北府宰相。
units.en: On gengyin day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Changge was made Northern Court chancellor.
units.literal: On gengyin day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Changge was made Northern Court chancellor.

units.zh: 丁酉，遣樞密直學士高端禮等諷宋罷伐夏兵。
units.en: On dingyou day privy council academician Gao Duanli and others were sent to admonish Song to cease attacking Xia troops.
units.literal: On dingyou day privy council academician Gao Duanli and others were dispatched to admonish Song to cease attacking Xia troops.

units.zh: 二月癸卯，微行，視民疾苦。
units.en: On guimao day of the second month the emperor made a private tour to observe the people's hardships.
units.literal: Second month, on guimao day made a private tour to observe the people's hardships.

units.zh: 丙午，幸鴛鴦濼。
units.en: On bingwu day the court went to Mandarin Duck Marsh.
units.literal: On bingwu day went to Mandarin Duck Marsh.

units.zh: 三月壬申，以族女南仙封成安公主，下嫁夏國王李乾順。
units.en: On renshen day of the third month a clanswoman Nanxian was enfeoffed Princess Cheng'an and married to Xia King Li Qianshun.
units.literal: Third month, on renshen day a clanswoman Nanxian was enfeoffed Princess Cheng'an and married to Xia King Li Qianshun.

units.zh: 夏四月甲申，射虎炭山。
units.en: On jiashen day of the fourth summer month the court shot tigers at Charcoal Mountain.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiashen day shot tigers at Charcoal Mountain.

units.zh: 五月癸卯，清暑南崖。
units.en: On guimao day of the fifth month the court took summer ease at Southern Cliff.
units.literal: Fifth month, on guimao day took summer ease at Southern Cliff.

units.zh: 壬子，宋遣曾孝廣、王戩報聘。
units.en: On renzi day Song sent Zeng Xiaoguang and Wang Jian on a return mission.
units.literal: On renzi day Song dispatched Zeng Xiaoguang and Wang Jian on a return mission.

units.zh: 六月甲戌，夏國遣使來謝，及貢方物。
units.en: On jiaxu day of the sixth month Xia State sent envoys to give thanks and present local goods.
units.literal: Sixth month, on jiaxu day Xia State dispatched envoys to give thanks and present local goods.

units.zh: 己丑，幸候里吉。
units.en: On jichou day the court went to Houliji.
units.literal: On jichou day went to Houliji.

units.zh: 秋七月，謁慶陵。
units.en: In the seventh autumn month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

units.zh: 九月辛亥，駐蹕藕絲澱。
units.en: On xinhai day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
units.literal: Ninth month, on xinhai day halted at Ousi Marsh.

units.zh: 乙卯，謁乾陵。
units.en: On yimao day the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.
units.literal: On yimao day paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 冬十一月戊戌，禁商賈之家應進士舉。
units.en: On wuxu day of the eleventh winter month merchants' households were forbidden to take the advanced-scholar examination.
units.literal: Winter, eleventh month, on wuxu day merchants' households were forbidden to take the advanced-scholar examination.

units.zh: 丙辰，高麗三韓國公王薨，子遣使來告。
units.en: On bingchen day Wang, Duke of the Three Han States of Goryeo died; his son sent envoys to announce it.
units.literal: On bingchen day Wang, Duke of the Three Han States of Goryeo died; his son dispatched envoys to announce it.

units.zh: 十二月己巳，夏國復遣李造福、田若水求援。
units.en: On jisi day of the twelfth month Xia State again sent Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on jisi day Xia State again dispatched Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.

units.zh: 癸酉，宋遣林洙來議與夏約和。
units.en: On guiyou day Song sent Lin Zhu to discuss a treaty of peace with Xia.
units.literal: On guiyou day Song dispatched Lin Zhu to discuss a treaty of peace with Xia.

units.zh: 六年春正月辛丑，遣知北院樞密使事蕭得里底、<四>知南院樞密使事牛溫舒使宋，諷歸所侵夏地。
units.en: In the sixth year, on xinchou day of the first spring month Xiao Delidi, who administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs, and [4] Niu Wenshu, who administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs, were sent as envoys to Song to admonish return of invaded Xia territory.
units.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on xinchou day dispatched Xiao Delidi, who administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs, and [4] Niu Wenshu, who administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs, as envoys to Song to admonish return of invaded Xia territory.

units.zh: 夏五月，清暑散水原。
units.en: In the fifth summer month the court took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.
units.literal: Summer, fifth month, took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.

units.zh: 六月辛巳，夏國遣李造福等來謝。
units.en: On xinsi day of the sixth month Xia State sent Li Zaofu and others to give thanks.
units.literal: Sixth month, on xinsi day Xia State dispatched Li Zaofu and others to give thanks.

units.zh: 秋七月癸巳，阻卜來貢。
units.en: On guisi day of the seventh autumn month Zubu came with tribute.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guisi day Zubu came with tribute.

units.zh: 甲午，如黑嶺。
units.en: On jiawu day the court went to Black Ridge.
units.literal: On jiawu day went to Black Ridge.

units.zh: 庚子，獵鹿角山。
units.en: On gengzi day the court hunted at Deer-Horn Mountain.
units.literal: On gengzi day hunted at Deer-Horn Mountain.

units.zh: 冬十月乙亥，宋與夏通好，遣劉正符、曹穆來告。
units.en: On yihai day of the tenth winter month Song and Xia opened relations; Liu Zhengfu and Cao Mu were sent to announce it.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yihai day Song and Xia opened relations; Liu Zhengfu and Cao Mu were dispatched to announce it.

units.zh: <五>庚辰，以皇太叔、南京留守和魯斡兼惕隱，東京留守、越國王淳為南府宰相。
units.en: [5] On gengchen day Imperial Grand Uncle and Nanjing intendant Heluwo was also made tiyin; Eastern Capital intendant and Prince of Yue Chun was made Southern Court chancellor.
units.literal: [5] On gengchen day Imperial Grand Uncle and Nanjing intendant Heluwo was also made tiyin; Eastern Capital intendant and Prince of Yue Chun was made Southern Court chancellor.

units.zh: 十一月乙未，以謝家奴為南院大王，馬奴為奚六部大王。
units.en: On yiwei day of the eleventh month Xiejianu was made Southern Court great king; Manu was made great king of Xi Six Divisions.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on yiwei day Xiejianu was made Southern Court great king; Manu was made great king of Xi Six Divisions.

units.zh: 丙申，行柴冊禮。
units.en: On bingshen day the firewood-bundle rite was performed.
units.literal: On bingshen day the firewood-bundle rite was performed.

units.zh: 戊戌，大赦。
units.en: On wuxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: On wuxu day general amnesty.

units.zh: 以和魯斡為義和仁聖皇太叔，<六>越國王淳進封魏國王，封皇子敖盧斡為晉王，習泥烈為饒樂郡王。
units.en: Heluwo was titled Imperial Grand Uncle of Yihe, Benevolent and Sagely; [6] Prince of Yue Chun was advanced to Prince of Wei; imperial son Aoluwo was enfeoffed Prince of Jin; Xini Lie was enfeoffed Prince of Raole Commandery.
units.literal: Heluwo was titled Imperial Grand Uncle of Yihe, Benevolent and Sagely; [6] Prince of Yue Chun was advanced to Prince of Wei; imperial son Aoluwo was enfeoffed Prince of Jin; Xini Lie was enfeoffed Prince of Raole Commandery.

units.zh: 己亥，謁太祖廟。
units.en: On jihai day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple.
units.literal: On jihai day paid respects at Taizu's temple.

units.zh: 甲辰，祠木葉山。
units.en: On jiachen day sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.
units.literal: On jiachen day sacrificed at Muye Mountain.

units.zh: 十二月己巳，封耶律儼為漆水郡王，餘官進爵有差。
units.en: On jisi day of the twelfth month Yelü Yan was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery; remaining offices and titles were promoted in differing degrees.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on jisi day Yelü Yan was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery; remaining offices and titles were promoted in differing degrees.

units.zh: 七年春正月，鉤魚於鴨子河。
units.en: In the seventh year, in the first spring month the court angled for fish at Huntong River.
units.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, angled for fish at Huntong River.

units.zh: 二月，駐蹕大魚濼。
units.en: In the second month the court halted at Great Fish Marsh.
units.literal: Second month, halted at Great Fish Marsh.

units.zh: 夏六月，次散水原。
units.en: In the sixth summer month the court stopped at Sanshui Plain.
units.literal: Summer, sixth month, stopped at Sanshui Plain.

units.zh: 秋七月，如黑嶺。
units.en: In the seventh autumn month the court went to Black Ridge.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, went to Black Ridge.

units.zh: 冬十月，謁乾陵，獵醫巫閭山。
units.en: In the tenth winter month the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum and hunted at Mount Yiwulü.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, paid respects at Qian Mausoleum and hunted at Mount Yiwulü.

units.zh: 是年，放進士李石等百人。
units.en: That year advanced scholars Li Shi and one hundred others were released.
units.literal: That year advanced scholars Li Shi and one hundred others were released.

units.zh: 八年春正月，如春州。
units.en: In the eighth year, in the first spring month the court went to Chun Prefecture.
units.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, went to Chun Prefecture.

units.zh: 夏四月丙申，封高麗王為三韓國公，贈其父為高麗國王<七>。
units.en: On bingshen day of the fourth summer month the Goryeo king was enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States and his father was posthumously enfeoffed King of Goryeo [7].
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingshen day the Goryeo king was enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States and his father was posthumously enfeoffed King of Goryeo [7].

units.zh: 五月，清暑散水原。
units.en: In the fifth month the court took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.
units.literal: Fifth month, took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.

units.zh: 六月壬辰，西北路招討使蕭敵里率諸蕃來朝。
units.en: On renchen day of the sixth month Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Dili led the various tribes to court.
units.literal: Sixth month, on renchen day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Dili led the various tribes to court.

units.zh: 丙申，射柳祈雨。
units.en: On bingshen day the court shot willow to pray for rain.
units.literal: On bingshen day shot willow to pray for rain.

units.zh: 壬寅，夏國王李乾順以成安公主生子，遣使來告。
units.en: On renyin day Xia King Li Qianshun, because Princess Cheng'an had borne a son, sent envoys to announce it.
units.literal: On renyin day Xia King Li Qianshun, because Princess Cheng'an had borne a son, dispatched envoys to announce it.

units.zh: 丁未，如黑嶺。
units.en: On dingwei day the court went to Black Ridge.
units.literal: On dingwei day went to Black Ridge.

units.zh: 秋七月戊辰，以雨罷獵。
units.en: On wuchen day of the seventh autumn month, because of rain, the hunt was abandoned.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuchen day, because of rain the hunt was abandoned.

units.zh: 冬十二月己卯，高麗遣使來謝。
units.en: On jimao day of the twelfth winter month Goryeo sent envoys to give thanks.
units.literal: Winter, twelfth month, on jimao day Goryeo dispatched envoys to give thanks.

units.zh: 九年春正月丙午朔，如鴨子河。
units.en: In the ninth year, on the bingwu new moon of the first spring month the court went to Huntong River.
units.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on bingwu new moon, went to Huntong River.

units.zh: 二月，如春州。
units.en: In the second month the court went to Chun Prefecture.
units.literal: Second month, went to Chun Prefecture.

units.zh: 三月戊午，夏國以宋不歸地，遣使來告。
units.en: On wuwu day of the third month, because Song did not return territory, Xia sent envoys to report it.
units.literal: Third month, on wuwu day, because Song did not return territory, Xia dispatched envoys to report it.

units.zh: 夏四月壬午，五國部來貢。
units.en: On renwu day of the fourth summer month the Five States Division came with tribute.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renwu day the Five States Division came with tribute.

units.zh: 六月乙亥，清暑特禮嶺。
units.en: On yihai day of the sixth month the court took summer ease at Teli Ridge.
units.literal: Sixth month, on yihai day took summer ease at Teli Ridge.

units.zh: 秋七月，隕霜，傷稼。
units.en: In the seventh autumn month frost fell and damaged the crops.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, frost fell and damaged the crops.

units.zh: 甲寅，獵于候里吉。
units.en: On jiayin day the court hunted at Houliji.
units.literal: On jiayin day hunted at Houliji.

units.zh: 八月丁酉，雪，罷獵。
units.en: On dingyou day of the eighth month snow fell and the hunt was abandoned.
units.literal: Eighth month, on dingyou day snow fell and the hunt was abandoned.

units.zh: 冬十月癸酉，望祠木葉山。
units.en: On guiyou day of the tenth winter month the court gazed in sacrifice at Muye Mountain.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on guiyou day gazed in sacrifice at Muye Mountain.

units.zh: 丁丑，詔免今年租稅。
units.en: On dingchou day an edict remitted this year's rent and tax.
units.literal: On dingchou day an edict remitted this year's rent and tax.

units.zh: 十二月甲申，高麗遣使來貢。
units.en: On jiashen day of the twelfth month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on jiashen day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 是年，放進士劉楨等九十人。
units.en: That year advanced scholars Liu Zhen and ninety others were released.
units.literal: That year advanced scholars Liu Zhen and ninety others were released.

units.zh: 十年春正月辛丑，預行立春禮。
units.en: In the tenth year, on xinchou day of the first spring month the early spring rite was performed in advance.
units.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on xinchou day the early spring rite was performed in advance.

units.zh: 如鴨子河。
units.en: The court went to Huntong River.
units.literal: Went to Huntong River.

units.zh: 二月庚午朔，駐蹕大魚濼。
units.en: On the gengwu new moon of the second month the court halted at Great Fish Marsh.
units.literal: Second month, on gengwu new moon, halted at Great Fish Marsh.

units.zh: 夏四月丙子，五國部長來貢。
units.en: On bingzi day of the fourth summer month chiefs of the Five States Division came with tribute.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingzi day chiefs of the Five States Division came with tribute.

units.zh: 丙戌，預行再生禮。
units.en: On bingxu day the rebirth rite was performed in advance.
units.literal: On bingxu day the rebirth rite was performed in advance.

units.zh: 癸巳，獵於北山。
units.en: On guisi day the court hunted at Northern Mountain.
units.literal: On guisi day hunted at Northern Mountain.

units.zh: 六月甲戌，清暑玉丘。
units.en: On jiaxu day of the sixth month the court took summer ease at Jade Mound.
units.literal: Sixth month, on jiaxu day took summer ease at Jade Mound.

units.zh: 癸未，夏國遣李造福等來貢。
units.en: On guiwei day Xia State sent Li Zaofu and others with tribute.
units.literal: On guiwei day Xia State dispatched Li Zaofu and others with tribute.

units.zh: 甲午，阻卜來貢。
units.en: On jiawu day Zubu came with tribute.
units.literal: On jiawu day Zubu came with tribute.

units.zh: 秋七月辛丑，謁慶陵。
units.en: On xinchou day of the seventh autumn month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinchou day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

units.zh: 閏月辛亥，謁懷陵。
units.en: In the intercalary month, on xinhai day the court paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.
units.literal: Intercalary month, on xinhai day paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.

units.zh: 己未，謁祖陵。
units.en: On jiwei day the court paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.
units.literal: On jiwei day paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.

units.zh: 壬戌，皇太叔和魯斡薨。
units.en: On renxu day Imperial Grand Uncle Heluwo died.
units.literal: On renxu day Imperial Grand Uncle Heluwo died.

units.zh: 九月甲戌，免重九節禮。
units.en: On jiaxu day of the ninth month the Double Ninth Festival rite was waived.
units.literal: Ninth month, on jiaxu day the Double Ninth Festival rite was waived.

units.zh: 冬十月，駐蹕藕絲澱。
units.en: In the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, halted at Ousi Marsh.

units.zh: 十二月己酉，改明年元。
units.en: On jiyou day of the twelfth month the coming year's era name was changed.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on jiyou day the coming year's era name was changed.

units.zh: 是歲，大饑。
units.en: That year there was great famine.
units.literal: That year there was great famine.

units.zh: 天慶元年春正月，鉤魚於鴨子河。
units.en: In the first year of Tianqing, in the first spring month, the court angled for fish on the Huntong River.
units.literal: In the first year of Tianqing, spring, first month, angled for fish at Huntong River.

units.zh: 二月，如春州。
units.en: In the second month the court went to Chun Prefecture.
units.literal: Second month, went to Chun Prefecture.

units.zh: 三月乙亥，五國部長來貢。
units.en: On yihai day of the third month chiefs of the Five States Division came with tribute.
units.literal: Third month, on yihai day chiefs of the Five States Division came with tribute.

units.zh: 夏五月，清暑散水原。
units.en: In the fifth summer month the court took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.
units.literal: Summer, fifth month, took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.

units.zh: 秋七月，獵。
units.en: In the seventh autumn month the court hunted.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, hunted.

units.zh: 冬十月，駐蹕藕絲澱。
units.en: In the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, halted at Ousi Marsh.

units.zh: 二年春正月己未朔，如鴨子河。
units.en: In the second year, on the jiwei new moon of the first spring month the court went to Huntong River.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on jiwei new moon, went to Huntong River.

units.zh: 丁丑，五國部長來貢。
units.en: On dingchou day chiefs of the Five States Division came with tribute.
units.literal: On dingchou day chiefs of the Five States Division came with tribute.

units.zh: 二月丁酉，如春州，幸混同江鉤魚，<八>界外生女直酋長在千里內者，以故事皆來朝。
units.en: On dingyou day of the second month the court went to Chun Prefecture and went to Huntong River to angle for fish; [8] Raw Jurchen chiefs within a thousand li by precedent all came to court.
units.literal: Second month, on dingyou day went to Chun Prefecture and went to Huntong River to angle for fish; [8] Raw Jurchen chiefs within a thousand li by precedent all came to court.

units.zh: 適遇「頭魚宴」，酒半酣，上臨軒，命諸酋次第起舞；
units.en: It happened to be the "Head-Fish Banquet"; when the wine was half gone the emperor came to the hall front and ordered the chiefs in turn to dance;
units.literal: It happened to be the "Head-Fish Banquet"; when the wine was half gone the emperor came to the hall front and ordered the chiefs in turn to dance;

units.zh: 獨阿骨打辭以不能。
units.en: Aguda alone declined, saying he could not.
units.literal: Aguda alone declined, saying he could not.

units.zh: 諭之再三，終不從。
units.en: He was admonished again and again but in the end would not comply.
units.literal: He was admonished again and again but in the end would not comply.

units.zh: 他日，上密謂樞密使蕭奉先曰：「前日之燕，阿骨打意氣雄豪，顧視不常，可托以邊事誅之。
units.en: Another day the emperor secretly told Privy Commissioner Xiao Fengxian, "At the banquet the other day Aguda's spirit was bold and heroic and his glances were unusual; he could be entrusted with a border affair and executed.
units.literal: Another day the emperor secretly told Privy Commissioner Xiao Fengxian: "At the banquet the other day Aguda's spirit was bold and heroic and his glances were unusual; he could be entrusted with a border affair and executed.

units.zh: 否則，必貽後患。」
units.en: Otherwise he will surely leave trouble for later."
units.literal: Otherwise he will surely leave trouble for later."

units.zh: 奉先曰：「寏人不知禮義，無大過而殺之，恐傷向化之心。
units.en: Fengxian said, "These wild people do not know ritual propriety; to kill them without great offense would surely wound hearts inclined toward transformation.
units.literal: Fengxian said: "These wild people do not know ritual propriety; to kill them without great offense would surely wound hearts inclined toward transformation.

units.zh: 假有異志，又何能為？」
units.en: Even if they had other intentions, what could they do?"
units.literal: Even if they had other intentions, what could they do?"

units.zh: 其弟吳乞買、粘罕、胡舍等嘗從獵，<九>能呼鹿，刺虎，搏熊。
units.en: His younger brothers Wukimai, Nianhan, Hushe, and others had once followed the hunt; [9] they could call deer, stab tigers, and wrestle bears.
units.literal: His younger brothers Wukimai, Nianhan, Hushe, and others had once followed the hunt; [9] they could call deer, stab tigers, and wrestle bears.

units.zh: 上喜，輒加官爵。
units.en: The emperor was pleased and repeatedly added office and titles.
units.literal: The emperor was pleased and repeatedly added office and titles.

units.zh: 夏六月庚寅，清暑南崖。
units.en: On gengyin day of the sixth summer month the court took summer ease at Southern Cliff.
units.literal: Summer, sixth month, on gengyin day took summer ease at Southern Cliff.

units.zh: 甲午，和州回鶻來貢。
units.en: On jiawu day Uighurs of Hezhou came with tribute.
units.literal: On jiawu day Uighurs of Hezhou came with tribute.

units.zh: 戊戌，成安公主來朝。
units.en: On wuxu day Princess Cheng'an came to court.
units.literal: On wuxu day Princess Cheng'an came to court.

units.zh: 甲辰，阻卜來貢。
units.en: On jiachen day Zubu came with tribute.
units.literal: On jiachen day Zubu came with tribute.

units.zh: 秋七月乙丑，獵南山。
units.en: On yichou day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Southern Mountain.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yichou day hunted at Southern Mountain.

units.zh: 九月己未，射獲熊，燕群臣，上親禦琵琶。
units.en: On jiwei day of the ninth month the court shot and obtained a bear, feasted the hundred officials, and the emperor personally played the pipa.
units.literal: Ninth month, on jiwei day shot and obtained a bear, feasted the hundred officials, and the emperor personally played the pipa.

units.zh: 初，阿骨打混同江宴歸，疑上知其異志，遂稱兵，先並旁近部族。
units.en: Initially, when Aguda returned from the Huntong River banquet he suspected the emperor knew his other intent and thereupon raised troops, first annexing nearby divisions.
units.literal: Initially, when Aguda returned from the Huntong River banquet he suspected the emperor knew his other intent and thereupon raised troops, first annexing nearby divisions.

units.zh: 女直趙三、阿鶻產拒之，阿骨打虜其家屬。
units.en: Jurchen Zhao San and Ahechan resisted; Aguda captured their families.
units.literal: Jurchen Zhao San and Ahechan resisted; Aguda captured their families.

units.zh: 二人走訴咸州，詳穩司送北樞密院。
units.en: The two men fled to complain at Xian Prefecture; the detailed-stable office sent them to the Northern Privy Council.
units.literal: The two men fled to complain at Xian Prefecture; the detailed-stable office sent them to the Northern Privy Council.

units.zh: 樞密使蕭奉先作常事以聞上，仍送咸州詰責，欲使自新。
units.en: Privy Commissioner Xiao Fengxian reported it as an ordinary matter to the emperor and still sent them back to Xian Prefecture to be questioned and rebuked, intending that they reform themselves.
units.literal: Privy Commissioner Xiao Fengxian reported it as an ordinary matter to the emperor and still sent them back to Xian Prefecture to be questioned and rebuked, intending that they reform themselves.

units.zh: 後數召，阿骨打竟稱疾不至。
units.en: After several summonses Aguda in the end claimed illness and did not come.
units.literal: After several summonses Aguda in the end claimed illness and did not come.

units.zh: 冬十月辛亥，高麗三韓國公王之母死，來告，即遣使致祭，起復。
units.en: On xinhai day of the tenth winter month the mother of Wang, Duke of the Three Han States of Goryeo died; envoys came to announce it; envoys were immediately sent to offer sacrifice and grant mourning leave.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinhai day the mother of Wang, Duke of the Three Han States of Goryeo died; envoys came to announce it; envoys were immediately dispatched to offer sacrifice and grant mourning leave.

units.zh: 是月，駐蹕奉聖州。
units.en: That month the court halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.
units.literal: That month halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.

units.zh: 十一月乙卯，幸南京。
units.en: On yimao day of the eleventh month the court went to Nanjing.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on yimao day went to Nanjing.

units.zh: 丁卯，謁太祖廟。
units.en: On dingmao day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple.
units.literal: On dingmao day paid respects at Taizu's temple.

units.zh: 是年，放進士韓等七十七人。
units.en: That year advanced scholars Han and seventy-seven others were released.
units.literal: That year advanced scholars Han and seventy-seven others were released.

units.zh: 三年春正月丙寅，賜南京貧民錢。
units.en: In the third year, on bingyin day of the first spring month money was bestowed on poor people of Nanjing.
units.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on bingyin day money was bestowed on poor people of Nanjing.

units.zh: 丁卯，如大魚濼。
units.en: On dingmao day the court went to Great Fish Marsh.
units.literal: On dingmao day went to Great Fish Marsh.

units.zh: 甲戌，禁僧尼破戒。
units.en: On jiaxu day monks and nuns were forbidden to break precepts.
units.literal: On jiaxu day monks and nuns were forbidden to break precepts.

units.zh: 丙子，獵狗牙山，大寒，獵人多死。
units.en: On bingzi day the court hunted at Dog Tooth Mountain; there was great cold and many hunters died.
units.literal: On bingzi day hunted at Dog Tooth Mountain; great cold; many hunters died.

units.zh: 三月，籍諸道戶，徙大牢古山圍場地居民于別土。
units.en: In the third month households of all circuits were registered; residents of the Dalao Hunting Ground were moved to other lands.
units.literal: Third month, households of all circuits were registered; residents of the Dalao Hunting Ground were moved to other lands.

units.zh: 阿骨打一日率五百騎突至咸州，吏民大驚。
units.en: One day Aguda led five hundred horsemen in a sudden dash to Xian Prefecture; officials and people were greatly alarmed.
units.literal: One day Aguda led five hundred horsemen in a sudden dash to Xian Prefecture; officials and people were greatly alarmed.

units.zh: 翌日，赴詳穩司，與趙三等面折庭下。
units.en: The next day he went to the detailed-stable office and faced Zhao San and the others in debate beneath the hall.
units.literal: The next day he went to the detailed-stable office and faced Zhao San and the others in debate beneath the hall.

units.zh: 阿骨打不屈，送所司問狀。
units.en: Aguda would not yield and was sent to the relevant office for questioning.
units.literal: Aguda would not yield and was sent to the relevant office for questioning.

units.zh: 一夕遁去。
units.en: In one night he fled.
units.literal: In one night he fled.

units.zh: 遣人訴於上，謂詳穩司欲見殺，故不敢留。
units.en: He sent men to complain to the emperor, saying the detailed-stable office wished to kill him, so he dared not stay.
units.literal: He sent men to complain to the emperor, saying the detailed-stable office wished to kill him, so he dared not stay.

units.zh: 自是召不復至。
units.en: From then on when summoned he never came again.
units.literal: From then on when summoned he never came again.

units.zh: 夏閏四月，李弘以左道聚眾為亂，支解，分示五京。
units.en: In the intercalary fourth summer month Li Hong gathered a crowd by heterodox ways and made disorder; he was dismembered and the parts displayed at the Five Capitals.
units.literal: Summer, intercalary fourth month, Li Hong gathered a crowd by heterodox ways and made disorder; he was dismembered and the parts displayed at the Five Capitals.

units.zh: 六月乙卯，斡朗改國遣使來貢良犬。
units.en: On yimao day of the sixth month Wolanggai State sent envoys presenting fine dogs.
units.literal: Sixth month, on yimao day Wolanggai State dispatched envoys presenting fine dogs.

units.zh: 丙辰，夏國遣使來貢。
units.en: On bingchen day Xia State sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On bingchen day Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 秋七月，幸秋山。
units.en: In the seventh autumn month the court went to Autumn Mountain.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, went to Autumn Mountain.

units.zh: 九月，駐蹕藕絲澱。
units.en: In the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
units.literal: Ninth month, halted at Ousi Marsh.

units.zh: 十一月甲午，以三司使虞融知南院樞密使事，西南面招討使蕭樂古為南府宰相。
units.en: On jiawu day of the eleventh month Three Departments commissioner Yu Rong administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs; Southwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Yegu was made Southern Court chancellor.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on jiawu day Three Departments commissioner Yu Rong administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs; Southwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Yegu was made Southern Court chancellor.

units.zh: 十二月庚戌，高麗遣使來謝致祭。
units.en: On gengxu day of the twelfth month Goryeo sent envoys to give thanks for the sacrificial mission.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on gengxu day Goryeo dispatched envoys to give thanks for the sacrificial mission.

units.zh: 癸丑，回鶻遣使來貢。
units.en: On guichou day Uighurs sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On guichou day Uighurs dispatched envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 甲寅，以樞密直學士馬人望三知政事。
units.en: On jiayin day privy council academician Ma Renwang was made third associate administrator of affairs.
units.literal: On jiayin day privy council academician Ma Renwang was third associate administrator of affairs.

units.zh: 丙辰，知樞密院事耶律儼薨。
units.en: On bingchen day Administrator of Privy Council Affairs Yelü Yan died.
units.literal: On bingchen day Administrator of Privy Council Affairs Yelü Yan died.

units.zh: 癸亥，高麗遣使來謝起復。
units.en: On guihai day Goryeo sent envoys to give thanks for mourning leave.
units.literal: On guihai day Goryeo dispatched envoys to give thanks for mourning leave.

units.zh: 四年春正月，如春州。
units.en: In the fourth year, in the first spring month the court went to Chun Prefecture.
units.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, went to Chun Prefecture.

units.zh: 初，女直起兵，以紇石烈部人阿疏不從，遣其部撒改討之。
units.en: Initially when Jurchen raised troops, because Ashu of the Hesilie division did not follow, they sent Sagai of their division to attack him.
units.literal: Initially when Jurchen raised troops, Ashu of the Hesilie division did not follow; his division was sent Sagai to attack him.

units.zh: 阿疏弟狄故保來告，詔諭使勿討，不聽，阿疏來奔。
units.en: Ashu's younger brother Dibao came to report; an edict admonished that he not be attacked; they did not listen; Ashu came to flee.
units.literal: Ashu's younger brother Dibao came to report; an edict admonished that he not be attacked; they did not listen; Ashu came to flee.

units.zh: 至是女直遣使來索，不發。
units.en: By then Jurchen sent envoys to demand him back; he was not handed over.
units.literal: By then Jurchen dispatched envoys to demand him back; he was not handed over.

units.zh: 夏五月，清暑散水原。
units.en: In the fifth summer month the court took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.
units.literal: Summer, fifth month, took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.

units.zh: 秋七月，女直復遣使取阿疏，不發，乃遣侍御阿息保問境上多建城堡之故。
units.en: In the seventh autumn month Jurchen again sent envoys to take Ashu; he was not handed over; Attendant-in-Waiting Axi Bao was then sent to ask the reason for many castles built on the border.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, Jurchen again dispatched envoys to take Ashu; he was not handed over; Attendant-in-Waiting Axi Bao was then dispatched to ask the reason for many castles built on the border.

units.zh: 女直以慢語答曰：「若還阿疏，朝貢如故；
units.en: Jurchen answered in insolent words, "If Ashu is returned, tribute as before;
units.literal: Jurchen answered in insolent words: "If Ashu is returned, tribute as before;

units.zh: 不然，城未能已。」
units.en: otherwise the building of castles cannot cease."
units.literal: otherwise the building of castles cannot cease."

units.zh: 遂發渾河北諸軍，益東北路統軍司。
units.en: Thereupon armies north of the Hun River were mobilized and the Northeast Route supreme command office was strengthened.
units.literal: Thereupon armies north of the Hun River were mobilized and the Northeast Route supreme command office was strengthened.

units.zh: 阿骨打乃與弟粘罕、胡舍等謀，一○：以銀術割、移烈、婁室、母等為帥，集女直諸部兵，擒遼障鷹官。
units.en: Aguda then plotted with his younger brothers Nianhan, Hushe, and others — [10]: making Yinjishuge, Yilie, Loushi, Mu, and others commanders, he gathered Jurchen divisions and captured Liao border hawk officials.
units.literal: Aguda then plotted with his younger brothers Nianhan, Hushe, and others — [10]: making Yinjishuge, Yilie, Loushi, Mu, and others commanders, he gathered Jurchen divisions and captured Liao border hawk officials.

units.zh: 及攻甯江州，東北路統軍司以聞。
units.en: When they attacked Ningjiang Prefecture, the Northeast Route supreme command office reported it.
units.literal: When they attacked Ningjiang Prefecture, the Northeast Route supreme command office reported it.

units.zh: 時上在慶州射鹿，聞之略不介意，遣海州刺史高仙壽統渤海軍應援。
units.en: At the time the emperor was shooting deer at Qing Prefecture; on hearing it he was little concerned and dispatched Haizhou prefect Gao Xianshou to command Bohai troops in relief.
units.literal: At the time the emperor was shooting deer at Qing Prefecture; on hearing it he was little concerned and dispatched Haizhou prefect Gao Xianshou to command Bohai troops in relief.

units.zh: 蕭撻不也遇女直，戰于甯江東，敗績。
units.en: Xiao Tabuye encountered Jurchen and fought east of Ningjiang; he was defeated.
units.literal: Xiao Tabuye encountered Jurchen and fought east of Ningjiang; he was defeated.

units.zh: 冬十月壬寅朔，一一：以守司空蕭嗣先為東北路都統，靜江軍節度使蕭撻不也為副，發契丹奚軍三千人，中京禁兵及土豪二千人，別選諸路武勇二千餘人，以虞候崔公義為都押官，控鶴指揮邢穎為副，引軍屯出河店。
units.en: On the renyin new moon of the tenth winter month — [11]: Acting Minister of Works Xiao Sixian was made northeast route commander-in-chief; Jingjiang Army military commissioner Xiao Tabuye was deputy; three thousand Khitan and Xi troops, Central Capital forbidden troops and local strongmen two thousand, and more than two thousand martial men selected from all routes — with scout-commander Cui Gongyi as chief escort officer and Crane-Control commander Xing Ying as deputy — led the army to encamp at Chuhe Store.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renyin new moon — [11]: Acting Minister of Works Xiao Sixian was made northeast route commander-in-chief; Jingjiang Army military commissioner Xiao Tabuye was deputy; three thousand Khitan and Xi troops, Central Capital forbidden troops and local strongmen two thousand, and more than two thousand martial men selected from all routes — with scout-commander Cui Gongyi as chief escort officer and Crane-Control commander Xing Ying as deputy — led the army to encamp at Chuhe Store.

units.zh: 兩軍對壘，女直軍潛渡混同江，掩擊遼眾。
units.en: The two armies faced each other; Jurchen troops secretly crossed Huntong River and struck the Liao force by surprise.
units.literal: The two armies faced each other; Jurchen troops secretly crossed Huntong River and struck the Liao force by surprise.

units.zh: 蕭嗣先軍潰，崔公義、邢穎、耶律佛留、蕭葛十等死之，其獲免者十有七人。
units.en: Xiao Sixian's army collapsed; Cui Gongyi, Xing Ying, Yelü Foliu, Xiao Geshi, and others died; of those who escaped barely seventeen men.
units.literal: Xiao Sixian's army collapsed; Cui Gongyi, Xing Ying, Yelü Foliu, Xiao Geshi, and others died; of those who escaped barely seventeen men.

units.zh: 蕭奉先懼其弟嗣先獲罪，輒奏東征潰軍所至劫掠，若不肆赦，恐聚為患。
units.en: Xiao Fengxian feared his younger brother Sixian would be punished and memorialized that the eastern expedition's routed troops everywhere plundered; unless a sweeping pardon were granted they might gather into trouble.
units.literal: Xiao Fengxian feared his younger brother Sixian would be punished and memorialized that the eastern expedition's routed troops everywhere plundered; unless a sweeping pardon were granted they might gather into trouble.

units.zh: 上從之，嗣先但免官而已。
units.en: The emperor followed this; Sixian was only dismissed from office.
units.literal: The emperor followed this; Sixian was only dismissed from office.

units.zh: 諸軍相謂曰：「戰則有死而無功，退則有生而無罪。」
units.en: The armies said to one another, "In battle there is death without merit; in retreat there is life without guilt."
units.literal: The armies said to one another: "In battle there is death without merit; in retreat there is life without guilt."

units.zh: 故士無鬥志，望風奔潰。
units.en: Therefore the soldiers had no fighting will and fled at sight of the wind.
units.literal: Therefore the soldiers had no fighting will and fled at sight of the wind.

units.zh: 十一月壬辰，都統蕭敵里等營於斡鄰濼東，又為女直所襲，士卒死者甚眾。
units.en: On renchen day of the eleventh month Commander-in-Chief Xiao Dili and others encamped east of Wolin Marsh and were again struck by Jurchen; very many soldiers died.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on renchen day Commander-in-Chief Xiao Dili and others encamped east of Wolin Marsh and were again struck by Jurchen; very many soldiers died.

units.zh: 甲午，蕭敵里亦坐免官。
units.en: On jiawu day Xiao Dili also was dismissed from office for the offense.
units.literal: On jiawu day Xiao Dili also was dismissed from office for the offense.

units.zh: 一二：辛丑，以西北路招討使耶律斡里朵為行軍都統，一三：副點檢蕭乙薛、同知南院樞密使事耶律章奴副之。
units.en: — [12]: On xinchou day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Woliduo was made field army commander-in-chief; — [13]: deputy inspector Xiao Yixue and associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhangnu were deputies.
units.literal: — [12]: On xinchou day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Woliduo was made field army commander-in-chief; — [13]: deputy inspector Xiao Yixue and associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhangnu were deputies.

units.zh: 十二月，咸、賓、祥三州及鐵驪、兀惹皆叛入女直。
units.en: In the twelfth month the three prefectures of Xian, Bin, and Xiang, as well as Iron Li and Wunai, all rebelled and went over to the Jurchen.
units.literal: Twelfth month, the three prefectures of Xian, Bin, and Xiang, as well as Iron Li and Wunai, all rebelled and went over to the Jurchen.

units.zh: 乙薛往援賓州，南軍諸將實婁、特烈等往援咸州，並為女直所敗。
units.en: Yixue went to relieve Bin Prefecture; southern army generals Shilou, Telie, and others went to relieve Xian Prefecture; all were defeated by Jurchen.
units.literal: Yixue went to relieve Bin Prefecture; southern army generals Shilou, Telie, and others went to relieve Xian Prefecture; all were defeated by Jurchen.
